psychological_meaning: Flax Smoke, a muted olive-green hue, evokes feelings of tranquility and natural harmony. It suggests stability, resilience, and a connection to the earth. This color promotes a sense of calm and groundedness, often associated with wisdom and maturity. It can also represent a subtle sophistication and understated elegance.
